name: Introduction and overview — E-2 Hawkeye — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — E-2 Hawkeye
description: Introduction and overview of the E-2 Hawkeye: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The E-2 Hawkeye is a twin-engine carrier-based early-warning aircraft built by Grumman (now Northrop Grumman), entering service in 1964. Its distinctive radar dome gives carrier strike groups airborne early warning and battle management. Over 200 have been built; the E-2D Advanced Hawkeye remains in production. Baseline facts: Carrier-based early-warning aircraft; service from 1964; 200+ built by Grumman/Northrop Grumman..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
